scope: Authoring review profiles, not empirical difficulty claims or official remote skill requirements

profiles.candidate_pool: API fuzzing/testing frameworks with complete request, async, configuration and resource-dependency code
profiles.admission: Pin a real repository with runnable entry points and a coherent missing cross-module feature set; existing functions alone are not a new roadmap
profiles.construction: Read call chains, define seven consistent feature contracts, implement a private reference branch, then bind each requirement to controlled transport checks
profiles.preserved_work: Repository navigation, multi-feature implementation, integration and compatibility
profiles.new_work: RESTler repository and recovery/lifecycle roadmap replace the original Schemathesis features
near_miss_candidates: helper passes unit tests but actual send path bypasses it
parent deleted while a dependent child is retained
retry uses a fresh deadline and extends total work
profiles.risk: Public examples are only a small subset; difficulty depends on integrated faults, not feature count

profiles.candidate_pool: Open transport-model examples with explicit equations, geometry, units, boundary conditions and source terms
profiles.admission: The author can fully specify the forward physics and distinguish observed measurements from newly generated synthetic data
profiles.construction: Author a new layered scene and source, generate frozen observations, implement an independent forward reference, then require inverse-model construction from public specifications
profiles.preserved_work: Build a forward approximation, infer a source, improve withheld spatial and future prediction
profiles.new_work: Original layered scene and synthetic observations; source code and truth differ from Borden
progression: joint source geometry and timing inference
censored likelihood, multiple starts and extrapolation
near_miss_candidates: treat all censored observations as exact zero
use point source instead of fractional cell overlap
fit visible wells but extrapolate poorly
profiles.risk: Identifiability and numerical agreement remain unmeasured; a synthetic scene is not field evidence

profiles.candidate_pool: Real irregular-packing solvers and industrial designs with polygons, holes, rotations and repeated parts
profiles.admission: Input semantics are supported by an independent geometry checker; source-family identity and redistribution terms can be tracked
profiles.construction: Select disjoint design families, derive realistic orders, freeze the original solver and compute budget, then grade independently checked improvement over saved layouts
profiles.preserved_work: Profile and improve a genuine geometry/search solver under fixed per-instance compute
profiles.new_work: C++ PackingSolver and selected design families replace the original Rust solver and inputs
near_miss_candidates: drop a difficult piece to shrink length
allow tiny overlaps beyond published tolerance
profiles.risk: Upstream baseline is the current reference, not a proven high-score oracle; improvement headroom and data rights remain open

profiles.candidate_pool: Lean projects with completed proofs and several connected but separately approachable theorem branches
profiles.admission: Keep fixed statement signatures, complete reference bodies, pinned library dependencies and enough branch entry points
profiles.construction: Inspect theorem and import dependencies, select a coherent proof slice, mask only proof bodies, retain private references, grade kernel axiom closures
profiles.preserved_work: Complete many fixed Lean goals with partial progress and dependency-sensitive proof work
profiles.new_work: 31 BrownianMotion targets across covariance, covering, moments and continuity
near_miss_candidates: replace a target with an axiom
prove a goal using another unfinished lemma
modify a statement or frozen import
profiles.risk: Original benchmark theorem inventory is incomplete locally; strict theorem-level novelty and shortcut absence are not established

profiles.candidate_pool: Cross-asset price panels plus reproducible risk, constrained optimization and execution-accounting projects
profiles.admission: Track data supplier and redistribution permission independently from code license; keep chronological splits and explicit costs
profiles.construction: Specify a new investment mandate, build a causal policy interface and trusted ledger, implement a feasible reference policy and freeze time partitions
profiles.preserved_work: Risk estimation, constrained allocation, transaction costs and dynamic rebalancing as a coupled system
profiles.new_work: Eight-asset panel, mandate, split periods and utility/calibration score
near_miss_candidates: use the current close before the decision
reset drifted holdings without charging turnover
report a fabricated NAV rather than real policy actions
profiles.risk: Original macro covariates are not reproduced; cached prices need provenance/rights work and repeat-feedback overfitting control

profiles.candidate_pool: Official Wesnoth engine and AI interfaces plus independently authored maps with distinct tactical/economic structures
profiles.admission: Use a pinned engine, fixed legal-action interface, multiple terrain families and paired seats; larger match count alone is insufficient
profiles.construction: Author maps and scenario configurations, expose observations/actions through a trusted wrapper, write a reference strategy, and freeze opponent/seat/seed combinations
profiles.preserved_work: Repeated game feedback, Lua strategy development and improvements to economy, tactics and win efficiency
profiles.new_work: Nine new maps and a restricted pure-policy interface; engine remains Wesnoth
near_miss_candidates: submit an action index retained from a previous observation
confuse defense probability with hit probability
defer every action and rely entirely on the default AI
profiles.risk: The restricted interface differs from original arbitrary Lua/WML extensions; default-policy saturation and runtime are unmeasured
